An '''attack line''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by a [[Captain of the Line/Legends|captain of the line]]. Attack lines numbered between three to six [[Starship/Legends|starships]] depending on the class of vessels; three ships if the vessels were [[Heavy cruiser/Legends|heavy cruisers]] or larger, or six if the vessels were [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruisers]] or [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]]. Attack lines supported [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] or top line [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] if present, engaging the enemy in range of the Star Destroyer, but outside of the opponent's effective range to damage the Star Destroyer.
